settings.label: Studio
settings.note: Not a shop. Just loud people.

settings.heading: Drop us a line.
settings.text: Order number handy? Pop it in the message and we will sort it faster.

settings.question: How do the sizes run?
settings.answer: True to size. Between two? Size up for room, down for a snug fit. The size guide on every product has the numbers.

settings.question: Can I exchange a pack?
settings.answer: Yes, within 15 days if the pack is unworn and still sealed. Write in with your order number and we will send the swap.

settings.question: When will my order arrive?
settings.answer: Most orders ship in 1 to 2 days and land in 3 to 6. You get a tracking link the moment it leaves.

settings.question: How do I wash them?
settings.answer: Cold, inside out, with similar colours. Skip the dryer and they stay loud for longer.

settings.question: Do you ship outside India?
settings.answer: Not yet. Join the crew on the home page and you will hear first when we do.

settings.text_1: SAY HI ✦ WE DON'T BITE ✦ REAL HUMANS
settings.text_2: 15-DAY EXCHANGES ✦ FAST REPLIES ✦ LOUD ON PURPOSE
